basic_info.description: Welcome to your 2025 fall project! 2018 23rd Street offers some lovely views, great natural light and a fantastic opportunity for a visionary to remodel this spacious home located in desirable sunny Potrero Hill neighborhood.  This traditional 1928 home has been owned by the same family for over 60 years. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, formal living room, separate dining room and a spacious kitchen.  Not to be missed is the oversized expansive garage with plenty of storage and tandem parking. Level backyard with lemon and pear trees and excellent space for gardening and entertaining.  Situated in a great community with so many amenities!  -  walking distance to desirable Starr King Elementary School, Starr King Open Space with its beautiful views, Potrero Hill Recreation Center and Potrero Branch Public Library. Enjoy the Mission District and 18th Street corridor with vibrant restaurants and shopping. Minutes away from grocery stores such as Safeway and Whole Foods.  Excellent proximity to Oracle Park, Chase Center, SF General, Kaiser and UCSF hospitals.   Convenient public transportation with access to CalTrain, BART, SFO and 101/280 freeways.  Enjoy the sweeping views and steep hills that Potrero Hill has to offer!
